notes.en: First independent Herdline candidate. Separate app ID io.github.erikfrish.herdline and host attachments under ~/.cache/herdline/attachments; Bellterm data is not migrated automatically. Includes guarded OMP Chat/Terminal, image and file attachments with per-host consent, Agents workspace filter, top dismissible banner, local Chat selection and an explicit Fit action that moves/crops the desktop but never sends automatically. Updates use verified Herdline GitHub release assets. Developer checked: 139 native tests and 401 JVM tests passed; Android instrumented tests compiled only, no runtime QA. Device resize/lifecycle, attachment/installer and held-grid cases remain unverified. Samsung Now Bar, Tern chat redesign and Safari-inspired tab overview are not claimed. Launcher glyph is provisional; final logo not yet approved.
